data.name: Liv
data.gender_notes: Liv is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Norse word 'liv' which means 'life' or 'lively'. In Norse mythology, Liv is the goddess of life and fertility. The name Liv carries the meaning “Lively, vibrant” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Liv usually hope their child will grow to embody lively, vibrant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Liv belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lively, vibrant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Liv total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
